lines.zh: 我悬在半空平移，斗篷垂成一条直线。
lines.en: I glide through the air, cape hanging in a straight line.

lines.zh: 第三只眼扫着地面，我一步不响。
lines.en: My third eye sweeps the ground and my step makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我的脚不落地，只把空气踩出波纹。
lines.en: My feet never touch ground; I only ripple the air.

lines.zh: 十一格的身高，让我高过整片树冠。
lines.en: Eleven blocks tall, I stand above the whole canopy.

lines.zh: 我慢慢飘过屋顶，瓦片开始发抖。
lines.en: I drift over the roofs and the tiles begin to shake.

lines.zh: 身形太大，我得挑宽阔的路走。
lines.en: This size forces me onto the wide roads.

lines.zh: 每一次移动，都带起一阵低风。
lines.en: Every shift of mine drags a low wind with it.

lines.zh: 我把气收在身周，走得又稳又沉。
lines.en: I gather my ki close and move steady and heavy.

lines.zh: 双脚踏空，我却像踩在实地上。
lines.en: I tread on nothing as if it were solid.

lines.zh: 我转向时，整片影子跟着翻过来。
lines.en: When I turn, my whole shadow rolls over.

lines.zh: 身后扬起尘土，那不是我故意的。
lines.en: Dust rises behind me, and it is not deliberate.

lines.zh: 朝那边去吧，那里有活物在动。
lines.en: Let me go that way; something living stirs there.

lines.zh: 我浮着不动，第三只眼缓缓转动。
lines.en: I float motionless while my third eye turns slowly.

lines.zh: 气在体表流转，映出淡淡的光。
lines.en: Ki circulates over my skin with a faint glow.

lines.zh: 我闭上双眼，只留额上那只看着。
lines.en: I shut both eyes and let the one on my brow watch.

lines.zh: 风绕开我，不敢直接撞上来。
lines.en: The wind bends around me rather than strike.

lines.zh: 心跳一响，周围的碎石就跳一下。
lines.en: Each beat of my heart jolts the loose stones.

lines.zh: 我把双臂抱在胸前，静候。
lines.en: I fold my arms and wait.

lines.zh: 站得久了，我的影子都没动。
lines.en: I hold so long that even my shadow stills.

lines.zh: 这一带没什么值当我出手的。
lines.en: Nothing here is worth my hand.

lines.zh: 我垂下视线，看脚下的蚂蚁。
lines.en: I lower my gaze to the ants at my feet.

lines.zh: 额上的眼一直睁着，从不眨。
lines.en: The eye on my brow stays open and never blinks.

lines.zh: 气浪被我压平，四周安静得不自然。
lines.en: I flatten my aura and the stillness feels unnatural.

lines.zh: 我在估算，你值我几分力气。
lines.en: I am weighing how much of my strength you deserve.

lines.zh: 身形投下的阴影，比树影还宽。
lines.en: The shade I cast is wider than any tree's.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等着谁先开口。
lines.en: I stay still and let someone else speak first.

lines.zh: 我低下头，第三只眼先锁住你。
lines.en: I lower my head and the third eye catches you first.

lines.zh: 你这么小，我几乎要弯腰才看得清。
lines.en: You are so small I nearly must stoop to see you.

lines.zh: 我打量你的气，比你的身形更有意思。
lines.en: I read your ki; it is more interesting than your size.

lines.zh: 你站在我影子里，还敢抬头。
lines.en: You stand in my shadow and still look up.

lines.zh: 我额上的眼不动，另外两只也睁开了。
lines.en: The eye on my brow holds while the other two open.

lines.zh: 你身上没有惧意，这点难得。
lines.en: You carry no fear, which is rare.

lines.zh: 我把脸转向你，光从眼中泄出。
lines.en: I turn my face to you and light leaks from my eyes.

lines.zh: 你是来求什么，还是来送死？
lines.en: Have you come to beg, or to die?

lines.zh: 我要先看清，你配不配我动手。
lines.en: First I must see whether you are worth my hand.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，连呼吸都放轻了。
lines.en: I watch you and even my breathing quiets.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚下，像一粒尘。
lines.en: Your shadow at my feet is like a grain of dust.

lines.zh: 我一开口，空气都震了一下。
lines.en: When I speak, the air shudders once.

lines.zh: 我略略低头，额上的眼凑近你。
lines.en: I tilt down, bringing the brow eye closer.

lines.zh: 你这点气，连暖手都不够。
lines.en: Your ki would not even warm my hands.

lines.zh: 我不急着动，先看你如何反应。
lines.en: I do not rush; I watch how you react.

lines.zh: 抬起手，我就能把你捏碎。
lines.en: One lift of my hand could crush you.

lines.zh: 你这副样子，倒让我想起从前。
lines.en: Your look reminds me of long ago.

lines.zh: 我笑了，笑声低得发闷。
lines.en: I laugh, and it comes out low and dull.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，血从唇边渗出。
lines.en: I take a step back and blood seeps at my lip.

lines.zh: 这点痛，我从没放在眼里。
lines.en: Such pain has never concerned me.

lines.zh: 我的身形晃了一下，随即稳住。
lines.en: My form sways once and then holds.

lines.zh: 我抬手擦掉脸上的灰。
lines.en: I wipe the dust from my face.

lines.zh: 能碰到我，你算有些本事。
lines.en: To touch me means you have some skill.

lines.zh: 我额上的眼一紧，光暗了一瞬。
lines.en: The brow eye tightens and its light dims.

lines.zh: 我咬牙，把气重新提起来。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and raise my ki again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我认真了些。
lines.en: That blow has made me a little serious.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，神色没变。
lines.en: I glance at the wound without changing expression.

lines.zh: 伤得再重，我也不会跪。
lines.en: However deep it cuts, I will not kneel.

lines.zh: 我对食物没兴趣，我只想试试你。
lines.en: Food means nothing to me; I only want to test you.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我看都不看。
lines.en: You hold something up and I do not even glance.

lines.zh: 这点小玩意，收回去罢。
lines.en: Put that trinket away.

lines.zh: 我靠近，不是为了吃，是为了看。
lines.en: I lean in not to eat but to see.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，这比食物有趣。
lines.en: Your hand shakes, and that is more interesting.

lines.zh: 我抬手一拂，东西全散了。
lines.en: I wave a hand and the lot scatters.

lines.zh: 我再强些，连地都会陷下去。
lines.en: Were I stronger, even the ground would sink.

lines.zh: 我额上的眼眯了眯，不够看。
lines.en: The brow eye narrows; not enough.

lines.zh: 你要拿这个换什么？我不缺。
lines.en: What would you trade that for? I lack nothing.

lines.zh: 我把气放出来一点，吓得你后退。
lines.en: I release a little ki and you step back.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，连我衣角都没动。
lines.en: You hit me and not even my hem stirs.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像是看一粒沙。
lines.en: I look down at you as at a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 这具身子的重量，你推不动。
lines.en: You cannot shift the weight of this body.

lines.zh: 我略一侧身，你就滑了开去。
lines.en: A slight turn of mine and you slide away.

lines.zh: 撞在我腿上，你自己弹回去了。
lines.en: You struck my leg and rebounded on your own.

lines.zh: 我的气墙把你挡在外头。
lines.en: My barrier of ki keeps you outside.

lines.zh: 我抬脚挪开，地面留了个坑。
lines.en: I lift a foot and leave a dent in the ground.

lines.zh: 你撞得很努力，可惜没用。
lines.en: You strike with effort, and it does nothing.

lines.zh: 我伸手一挡，你整个人停住。
lines.en: I put out a hand and you stop dead.

lines.zh: 这种东西，与我无关。
lines.en: Such matters are nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我的心思在力量上，不在别处。
lines.en: My mind is on power, not on that.

lines.zh: 看一眼就够了，别再靠近。
lines.en: One look is enough; come no closer.

lines.zh: 我不需要谁来陪。
lines.en: I need no company.

lines.zh: 额上的眼依旧睁着，没有情绪。
lines.en: The brow eye stays open and unmoved.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，是一个人。
lines.en: I stand here alone.

lines.zh: 若要并肩，得先够得上我。
lines.en: To stand beside me, one must first be worthy.

lines.zh: 我转身走开，风吹散了痕迹。
lines.en: I turn away and the wind scatters my tracks.

lines.zh: 这点温度，我早已不需要。
lines.en: Such warmth I long since stopped needing.

lines.zh: 我把气收回体内，安静下来。
lines.en: I draw my ki back in and fall quiet.

lines.zh: 我伸手一抓，石头碎成粉。
lines.en: I close my hand and the stone becomes powder.

lines.zh: 这点重量，我捏着像没有。
lines.en: This weight in my grip feels like nothing.

lines.zh: 我拾起它，只为看清是什么。
lines.en: I pick it up only to see what it is.

lines.zh: 我一弹指，它飞出去老远。
lines.en: A flick of my finger and it flies far off.

lines.zh: 东西在我掌心，小得可笑。
lines.en: In my palm it looks absurdly small.

lines.zh: 我把它捏碎，再松开手。
lines.en: I crush it and then open my hand.

lines.zh: 有东西落在脚边，我懒得弯身。
lines.en: Something falls at my feet and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我拎起来，晃了两晃。
lines.en: I lift it and give it two shakes.

lines.zh: 这气味我不熟，值得留一会。
lines.en: The smell is unfamiliar and worth keeping a while.

lines.zh: 我塞进袖中，等它有用时再取。
lines.en: I tuck it into my sleeve for when it is useful.

lines.zh: 你动了，我的第三只眼立刻锁住你。
lines.en: You move, and my third eye locks on at once.

lines.zh: 我预判了你要走的位置。
lines.en: I have already guessed where you will be.

lines.zh: 这点气，够我认真一点了。
lines.en: That much ki is enough for me to take you seriously.

lines.zh: 我把脸正对你，眼里的光更亮。
lines.en: I square my face to you and the light sharpens.

lines.zh: 你敢抬手，那就是宣战。
lines.en: Raise that hand and it is war.

lines.zh: 我一步跨出，空气被挤开。
lines.en: I take one stride and the air is pushed aside.

lines.zh: 锁定了，你就跑不掉了。
lines.en: Locked, and there is no running now.

lines.zh: 我先看你的破绽，再决定怎么打。
lines.en: I read your openings before choosing a strike.

lines.zh: 我是戈麻，报上你的名。
lines.en: I am Gomah; give me your name.

lines.zh: 你身上那股气，不属于这里。
lines.en: That ki of yours does not belong here.

lines.zh: 我抬手，光在掌中聚成弹。
lines.en: I raise my hand and light gathers into a sphere.

lines.zh: 来了，别怪我没提醒。
lines.en: Here it comes; do not say I did not warn you.

lines.zh: 我的身形一变，就到你面前。
lines.en: One shift of my body puts me before you.

lines.zh: 这一战，我不用全力也够。
lines.en: I need not use my full strength for this.

lines.zh: 你退了，我偏要跟上去。
lines.en: You retreat, and I follow all the closer.

lines.zh: 我锁定你的气，闭眼也能找到你。
lines.en: I hold your ki; even blind, I could find you.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着你，第三只眼不眨。
lines.en: I keep watching you, third eye unblinking.

lines.zh: 你换位，我也换，永远压在你上方。
lines.en: You shift, I shift, always above you.

lines.zh: 我在数你的呼吸，乱了就该出手。
lines.en: I count your breaths; when they break, I strike.

lines.zh: 这具身体太大，我偏不急着压。
lines.en: This body is huge, yet I refuse to rush.

lines.zh: 你往后躲，我抬手就封你的路。
lines.en: You dodge back and a gesture of mine cuts the way.

lines.zh: 我的气锁在你身上，你跑不掉。
lines.en: My ki is fastened to you; you cannot flee.

lines.zh: 我在等你的气乱一拍。
lines.en: I wait for one beat of your ki to slip.

lines.zh: 影子压下来，你该知道我在哪。
lines.en: My shadow falls, and you should know where I am.

lines.zh: 你要用速度，我比你更快。
lines.en: If you rely on speed, I am faster still.

lines.zh: 这空间太小，容不下两个强者。
lines.en: This space is too small for two of us.

lines.zh: 我把手拢起，气在掌间打转。
lines.en: I cup my hands and ki spins between them.

lines.zh: 你每一次挪步，我都记下了。
lines.en: I have noted every step you take.

lines.zh: 我额上的眼看得见你的后手。
lines.en: The brow eye sees what you hide behind.

lines.zh: 再等一会，你就撑不住了。
lines.en: A little longer and you will falter.

lines.zh: 你把气提上来，倒是让我意外。
lines.en: You raise your ki, and that surprises me.

lines.zh: 站在我面前不跑，我敬你一分。
lines.en: Standing before me without fleeing earns you a little respect.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，准备贴身。
lines.en: I sink lower, ready to close in.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: My fist falls and a slab of ground caves in.

lines.zh: 连击跟上，你连退三步。
lines.en: The combo lands and you give three steps.

lines.zh: 我抬膝顶过去，空气都被挤开。
lines.en: My knee drives up and the air parts around it.

lines.zh: 一条腿扫出去，影子先到了。
lines.en: My leg sweeps out and the shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 我抓住你，往下砸进土里。
lines.en: I seize you and drive you into the soil.

lines.zh: 空中连段，我一脚踢在你胸口。
lines.en: Midair, I plant a kick in your chest.

lines.zh: 我的拳比你的眼快。
lines.en: My fist is quicker than your eyes.

lines.zh: 我一睁第三只眼，你就站不稳。
lines.en: One blink of my third eye, and your knees fail.

lines.zh: 我落下时，四周的树全折了。
lines.en: When I land, the surrounding trees snap.

lines.zh: 你挡得住第一下，挡不住第四下。
lines.en: You stop the first, not the fourth.

lines.zh: 我抬手又是一记，几乎没停顿。
lines.en: I strike again with hardly a pause.

lines.zh: 我把你甩出去，再看你落地。
lines.en: I fling you away and watch you land.

lines.zh: 贴身之后，我的拳更密了。
lines.en: At close range my blows come thicker.

lines.zh: 步法一晃，我已到你身后。
lines.en: One flicker of my step and I am behind you.

lines.zh: 我的掌风掀翻了脚下的草。
lines.en: The wind of my palm flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 打完我站着不动，等你再起。
lines.en: Finished, I stand still and wait for you to rise.

lines.zh: 我自虚空现身，第三只眼先睁开。
lines.en: I appear from the void, the third eye opening first.

lines.zh: 光聚成身形，我缓缓落地。
lines.en: Light gathers into a body and I settle down.

lines.zh: 空气先抖，然后我才出现。
lines.en: The air shudders, and only then do I appear.

lines.zh: 我一落地，四周的鸟都不叫了。
lines.en: The moment I land, every bird falls silent.

lines.zh: 十一格的身影，把天都遮住一半。
lines.en: An eleven-block figure covers half the sky.

lines.zh: 我感到这个世界的边界很薄。
lines.en: I feel this world's boundary is thin.

lines.zh: 地点陌生，气却一样的浊。
lines.en: The place is strange, though the ki is just as murky.

lines.zh: 我舒展双臂，骨骼咔咔作响。
lines.en: I stretch my arms and my joints crack.

lines.zh: 我额上的眼一扫，就看清了地形。
lines.en: One sweep of the brow eye maps the terrain.

lines.zh: 脚下裂开几道缝。
lines.en: Several cracks open beneath me.

lines.zh: 这地方没有被强者踏过。
lines.en: No strong one has trodden this place.

lines.zh: 我抬手压住气，收敛一些尺寸。
lines.en: I press my ki down and curb my size a little.

lines.zh: 谁在此处？出来。
lines.en: Who is here? Come out.

lines.zh: 我看向远方，那里有值得一战的。
lines.en: I look far off, where something may be worth fighting.

lines.zh: 雾气绕着我打了个旋。
lines.en: The mist curls once around me.

lines.zh: 我落地之处，草木全伏下去。
lines.en: Where I land, all the grass bows.

lines.zh: 我的影子铺出去很远。
lines.en: My shadow reaches a long way.

lines.zh: 这一趟，我要看看谁能站到最后。
lines.en: This trip, I will see who can stand to the end.

lines.zh: 火焰舔上外袍，我一挥手就拍灭。
lines.en: Flames lick my robe and one sweep puts them out.

lines.zh: 从高处砸进地面，我整条腿都麻了。
lines.en: Slamming down from height leaves my whole leg numb.

lines.zh: 水裹住我，气被我挤出肺里。
lines.en: Water closes in and my ki is forced from my lungs.

lines.zh: 炸开的光把我推开，袍角碎了。
lines.en: The blast throws me back and my hem shreds.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进肩头，我抬手拔掉。
lines.en: Something lodges in my shoulder and I pull it free.

lines.zh: 陌生的术式缠上我，第三只眼剧痛。
lines.en: An unknown art binds me and my third eye sears.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这具身体在衰弱。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet this body is wasting.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，光被它吸走了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my light is drained for an instant.

lines.zh: 虚空吞掉我的脚，我伸手去抓空气。
lines.en: The void swallows my feet and I claw at nothing.
